source: reconstruction: Interrogation (LIFLFPPBUUT11SP, hub 67, not in tinyspeck/glitch-locations); layout from its 2011-03-26 render (720 x 864, reference only) at 1.5 street px per render px, CC0 bldg_int_bhall.swf decos (cubicle walls, waiting-room pictogram, light glow, door) and groddle1.swf hanging_lightbulb
label: Interrogation

why.street: inc_data_maps_prod.js:17992 (hub 67 Multiplayer Quests, the developers' hub); no location XML, no GSJS code; nothing in the game led in.
why.bounds: Street images are drawn 720 px wide; the render is 720 x 864 and its partitions and sign are Tiny Speck's cubicle walls and waiting-room pictogram at 1.5 x their render size, so the street is 1080 x 1296.
why.layout: Render: the bulb over a booth in a row of speckled partitions, the waiting-room pictogram over the gap, a red-brown chair in it, the floor at render y 652; black all round.
why.art: bldg_int_bhall.swf: cubicle_wall_left/_right/_double, bureaucratic_hall_waitingroom_1, bureaucratic_hall_light_ray_1, door_asset_bureaucratic_hall_int; groddle1.swf hanging_lightbulb; the hall's waiting chair recoloured (tools/interrogation/build-chair.mjs).
why.wayIn: Ours: the console's Go to the Interrogation room, for an online administrator (realtime teleport into the booth). No door for anyone else.
why.wayOut: Ours: the hall's interior door at the left goes back to where the visitor came from (features/interrogation-room-feature.js).
why.light: Ours: a fixed pool of light round the bulb over the hall's plaster tone; the room keeps its own light (ownLight) and is quiet (no music_file survives).
why.notBuilt: The dark beam and the two plastered frames over the partitions in the render: no CC0 piece found.
